name: aws-infin8
description: The AWS MCP Server, signed with the Infin8 IT Identity Center SSO profiles: infin8-takeoff-sdlc (default) and infin8it-takeoff-prod (per call, via aws_profile). The same pinned proxy as the official aws-core plugin, minus its --skip-auth, so every API call is SigV4-signed with the caller's own SSO session.
